$comment: The ratchet for the geometry-only rule (spec section 6, Rule 06).
THIS FILE ONLY SHRINKS. Every entry is a token that violates the current
rule and predates it. New violations are not admitted here — the gate fails
instead. When a token is fixed in Figma and re-exported, delete its line;
the gate also fails if an entry no longer violates, so the list cannot rot.
70 of the 89 component tokens were 1:1 forwards of a semantic token —
`badge/success/bg` existed only to say `= bg/success/subtle`. That layer
cost 79% of the tier and bought nothing, and it is where the Figma/code
desyncs happened: a token on one side, a direct semantic binding on the
other. Retiring it takes the projection at 100 components from ~2,200
Retiring one entry means: rebind the Figma component to the semantic token,
point the CSS at the semantic variable, delete the Figma variable,
re-export, remove the line here. Do it per component, not in one pass.

tabs.reason: Tabs carries per-size item padding-y (3) that the control scale does not yet offer, plus two track geometries per type. Adding control/<step>/padding-y absorbs 3 and brings this under budget; until then the overage is on the record rather than silently allowed.
